notes.title: 0.8.0 Version Update
notes.content:
·Added several challenge levels that require completing defensive tasks under different constraints

·Add a new building called 【Alchemy Pot】 to provide poison quenching effects for nearby allies

·Four advanced options have been added to the campaign level, allowing for new experiences under modified rules

·Balance adjustment: Endless mode - the enemy's movement speed in the defensive position will gradually increase with wave frequency; The health and attack power of all heroes are reduced; The upgrade probability provided by the talent and profession of hero 【Del】 is reduced, and the range of action of the ultimate skill overclocking is increased; The calculation method for the multiple stacking of energy enhancing light curtains in a prism tower has been changed from multiplication to addition; The enemy's toxicity attacks have been adjusted from fixed damage to varying attack power ratios

·Improved image quality with softer lighting and shadows; Added hit and death effects to monsters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841953/418568f98d03bd00eba2e1854ce901171fdbecc9.png[/img]

notes.title: 0.7.7 Version Update
notes.content:
· Two new maps have been added, a easy level [buffer] and a hard level [valve] 

 · A new defense tower has been added: [UAV platform], which can dispatch drones to any location on the battlefield for support; [X Bomb], a bomb that detonates immediately and can eliminate multiple enemies concentrated together.

 ·  In the endless mode of Survivor, [Ancient Stele] will appear, which can be occupied by heroes and unlocked with special technologies. Currently, 6 new technologies can be unlocked. Please explore and discover the specific effects in the game; 

 · Balance adjustment has reduced the duration of the control effect on the boss to 1/3; Nowadays, defense towers have different construction cooling times, and large defense towers have longer construction cooling times than small defense towers; Heroes and mechs can now be placed directly on traps, bridges, and ice surfaces, and traps can also be placed on bridges and ice surfaces. 

 · Fixed some bugs

notes.title: 0.7.6 Version Update

tags.feature: ·Added a new neutral building [Ancient  Stele ], using hero occupation can earn global bonuses
·Added a challenging map called [Ritual Altar], utilizing knowledge from ancient civilizations to resist the swarming evil creatures

tags.balance_change: ·The healing aura (Lunar Pillar/Sunflower) has been adjusted from health bonus to attack bonus; The upper limit of damage reduction is adjusted to 90%; The second architectural selection in evolutionary mode always leads to the emergence of high-end buildings now; The boost effect of the Cheer chip in the Sonic Tower has been improved, and the Sonic Tower can now detect and display hidden enemies;

notes.title: 0.7.5 Version Update
notes.content:
· Added a easy map [Jungle Temple] and three new monsters, don't let them escape.

 · Newly added defense tower [Naval Bomber], which can be placed on the water surface to drop bombs and attack enemies in the water; Newly added defense tower [Sonic Tower], which can deal damage to a group of enemies, but has a slower attack speed; Several exclusive chips have been added, including the Light Tower - [Lens], Deep Water Bomber - [Ejection], and Soundtower - [Cheer]. Please refer to the game for specific effects. 

 · Balance Adjustment: The ultimate skill of Fio, Bullet Storm, has reduced damage but can penetrate multiple enemies; In the fortified position mode, the addition of [Barries] as an additional initial building.
 
· Monster movement optimization means that monsters will no longer be completely crowded together; Weapon trajectory optimization, now both projectile and flat fire weapons calculate the advance of monster movement to improve hit rate. The reward for clearing high waves in endless mode has increased.

tags.balance_change: ·Evolution mode revision, chip upgrade changed to using gold coins for purchase; The difficulty of Endless Mode has also been slightly adjusted, and the specific balance is currently being tested

notes.title: 0.7.2 Version Update

tags.feature: · Added a new defense unit [Guardian MK-II], a powerful walking mech that can be moved to other positions for support when needed;
· Added a new intermediate battle map [Mirkwook], which has no mineral resources and can only rely on initial and regular aid funds to build defense lines.

tags.balance_change: · Balance adjustment: Unconventional chips in the upgrade route of defense tower chips (such as Hammer+Repair) will now appear in evolution mode

notes.title: 0.7.0 Version Update
notes.content:
· Added a medium difficulty map [City of Ashes], the map area will gradually open as the lava cools; At the same time, a new boss called "Ghost Lord" has been added, which will summon harvesters to raid your position. 

 · Balance adjustment: The monster "Sunflower" can only heal other enemies and will no longer heal itself; Monster [Ghost Mage] summons ghosts at a lower frequency, while reducing health and increasing speed. 

 · Added automatic save function, allowing players to read files and continue playing after abnormal or forced exits.

notes.title: 0.6.8 Version Update
notes.content:
·Added lava style levels and monsters, including a new map and three new monsters. The terrain in lava levels will undergo periodic changes, requiring dynamic adjustment of defense formations

·When using lower levels of special effects, frame skipping will be enabled to reduce performance consumption

notes.content:
· Balance adjustment: The speed and health of the Wolf King BOSS are reduced; The difficulty of Endless Mode has increased after 40 waves.

notes.title: Version 0.6.6 Update
notes.content:
·A new defense tower [ICBM] has been added, which can manually launch a nuclear missile to any location on the battlefield after loading.
·A new difficult battle [Commander's Training Ground] has been added, which requires building paths to block enemies.
·Balance adjustment: Missile buildings can no longer install split chips.
·Experience optimization: Added special effects level switching in the settings, allowing for setting lower feature levels if stuttering during endless gameplay; The difficulty level of the campaign has been reduced from level 5 to level 3.
·Bug fix: Fixed bugs that caused abnormal damage to sniper chips, harvest chips, challenge chips, and malice chips; Removing the Scorpion Elder BOSS from the Lost Throne once caused the game to crash.

notes.title: Version 0.6.5 Update
notes.content:
·In this version, we have added a new optional hero, Engineer Dell, who is skilled in mechanics and computers and can repair and enhance your defense towers.
·Another major update is Endless Mode, which challenges increasingly powerful enemies in randomly generated maps. In this mode, your chip can be upgraded to higher levels.
·A new map [Blue Star Bay] has been added with multiple defensive lines, making it easier to divide enemy formations and engage in battles.
·In addition, there are some balance adjustments, and upgrading buildings can now enhance more attributes; The Flame Tower and Shotgun Tower have gained an increase in health and attack power; Plasma Gun have weakened their attack power and range, but its prices have also been lowered.
·Fixed some bugs.

notes.title: v0.6.2 Version Update
notes.content:
The content of this update
[list]
[*]3 new defense towers: Shotgun towers, firing multiple bullets at once; Trap, can briefly trap passing enemies; Prism tower, can concentrate light beams and cause extremely high individual damage.

[*] A new difficult desert map: The sand sea, facing enemies from all directions in the endless yellow sand.

[*] Achievement system, adding 18 new achievements for challenge, completing achievements can also receive various rewards.

[*] A large number of experience optimizations, shortcut keys, map labels, defense tower level labels, defense tower brief information, and so on.

[*]  Balance adjustment, reduced money required for level 4 and 5 upgrades, reduced cooldown for Fio and Velonica's skills, and minor adjustments to some defense tower values.

[/list]
